channel.title: The Car Jury, News
channel.description: News and verdicts on the Indian car market from The Car Jury.

item.title: Tata Nexon Gets Rs 75,000 Off In October As Discounts Spread Across The Range
item.description: Tata's October 2026 offers bring up to Rs 75,000 off the Nexon and Rs 1.25 lakh off the Curvv, with benefits across the ICE line-up.

item.title: Kia Sorento Accessories List: 21 Add-Ons for the Rs 27.99 Lakh Flagship
